subject: Check used or remaining hours per month

messages.author: 454fc4c11143deca
messages.subject: Check used or remaining hours per month
parts:
I'd like to ask how to check the used or remaining hours of viewing of the app for the current month. In my dashboard, I can only see the last 7 days in the main screen, and then longer periods BUT WITHOUT the hours graph. 

Many thanks!!

P.S. I already posted this question on the 'Shiny' proper group but not receiving any answers, I'd like to try here.

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Check used or remaining hours per month
parts: If you go to the dashboard, to Account -> Usage, you should be able to see usage for 1 day, 1 week, 1 month, 3 months or the current cycle.
